title: Free evidence drills: backup restore, crash recovery, device checklist
problem: Backups, crash recovery and real-device behaviour have no evidence yet (the free half of PLAN-003).
scope: Export and restore drill for the online room data (Durable Objects) on the preview server, with the steps written down
Room crash-recovery test: stop a room mid-game and check players can continue
A real-device checklist (set-up, a full game, an online room, rotate, background and resume) as a one-page sheet for the phones the owner has
Live smoke test run from CI against the preview
exclusions: Touching the live game or live data

acceptance.text: A room restored from an export continues the game it held
acceptance.evidence: At the logic level: tests/room.test.ts "a room restored from its saved data": the room data is copied as stored, a new room object is made from it, both players reconnect with their tokens and the match finishes. The real Durable Object export and restore on the preview server was NOT run.

acceptance.text: After a forced room restart both players can continue the same game
acceptance.evidence: Same test: a room object rebuilt from saved data (a restart) lets both players continue the same game. A forced restart of the real room on the preview server was NOT run.

acceptance.text: The device checklist is run on at least two real phones and results are recorded
acceptance.evidence: The checklist is written (docs/DEVICE-CHECKLIST.md); it has not been run on a phone.

acceptance.text: The preview smoke test passes in CI
